question: President Ram Nath Kovind conferred which award on Matha B Manjamma for Jogati Nrithyaa in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Shri.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Matha B Manjamma** was conferred the** Padma Shri award in 2021 **by President **Ram Nath Kovind**.
 
• She was awarded in recognition of her contribution to **Jogati Nritya** and other folk forms.
